items: 【Sleeping Headphones & Music Headband& Sleep Mask 】2025 New Bluetooth Headband with built-in lightweight speakers, no need to wear extra earphones for insomnia, relaxation, meditation, traveling and more. Perfect for shift workers, tinnitus sufferers, and those who share a bed with a snorer, wearing this musical headband will allow you to sleep better.

【Side Sleeper's Sleeping Companion】The control module of this headband headphones is set in the middle of the forehead, it won't press on the ears when lying down, perfect for flat or side sleepers. The upgraded ultra-thin speakers are comfortable to wear and a great companion for listening to blogs and music before falling asleep. (Please adjust the position of the speakers left and right after wearing the headband to align them at your cochlea for a better sound quality experience).

【Comfortable & Breathable Material Headband】Bluetooth headphones headband is made of 95% polyester fiber and 5% spandex, it is very elastic and fits most head shapes. The Bluetooth headband absorbs sweat, breathes and dries quickly to keep sweat and hair out of your eyes while exercising, perfect for jogging or working out. (Please remove the Bluetooth module before washing it.)

【Long Battery Life & Sstereo Sound】The sleeping headphones have a powerful built-in rechargeable battery that provides over 12 hours of playback time after only 1-2 hours of charging, so you can enjoy music or audiobooks all night long. The high quality chip provides clear sound during exercise, and the simple buttons and their easy operation make exercise simpler!

【Perfect Gift for Men/Women】You will receive the package including 2 x Bluetooth Headband (Black&Gray) , 2 pair of Speakers,1 x USB Cable, 1 x User Manual. The two-piece Bluetooth headband is great for you to share and use with your family, or for multiple locations. A thoughtful gift for yourself or friends and family.
